messages:
Priya: Heads up 1: our invoice preview shows a weird uptick for a small cohort of streaming-heavy tenants starting ~04:10 UTC. Suspicious double-counting on streaming sessions. Anyone on meter side awake?
Owen: I was digging. We shipped `batch_coalesce_v2` on edge yesterday to reduce per-token overhead. It coalesces very short streaming chunks into a single metering envelope. Looks like for some clients we get both a coalesced 'stream' event and a later 'finalize' event for the same session. Those end up as two metering rows.
Alex: So the optimization created duplicate logical events. Are they identical enough for our dedupe to catch?
Owen: Not exactly. The stream event uses `session_id` and a lightweight fingerprint; the finalize event includes `finalize_token_count` and a different fingerprint because `finalization=true`. In the old code both paths were identical, but v2 split them to optimize payload size.
Priya: That explains why only streaming-heavy tenants are affected. They see 1.8-3.6% bump in token totals for some windows. BillingOps, this will impact previews for customers on monthly plans.
BillingOps: Thanks for the flag. We'll need a corrective plan if this persists. Can you estimate affected invoice delta per tenant?
Owen: Early numbers: 22 tenants > 1% preview delta, 7 tenants > 2.5%. I'm running a job to compute per-tenant diffs for last 24h.
infra-bot: alert: metering.event_dups_rate > 0.5% (5m) in prod-us-east. Investigate: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/AX12/metering-overview
Alex: Immediate mitigation options: 1) revert batch_coalesce_v2 at edge (fast but loses perf wins), 2) make finalize path emit a `billing_id` that matches the coalesced stream fingerprint so downstream dedupe catches it, 3) change consumer dedupe to ignore `finalization` flag in fingerprint for a short window.
Priya: Revert seems safest for now while we fix semantics. Can we do a targeted rollback only for streaming-capable clients (by header)?
Owen: Yes, the rollout has a feature-flag gate `edge:coalesce-streaming`. We can flip it for 100% of tenants flagged as streaming-heavy as a stopgap. Rollback PR: https://github.com/redwood/edge/pull/5891
BillingOps: If we rollback, can we also publish a note in the console "Invoice previews may be noisy"? Customers saw previews earlier today and asked Support.
Alex: I'll draft a short console banner + link to a KB. Priya, can you coordinate copy with Support?
Priya: On it. I'll post draft in #support after we agree wording.
Owen: Long-term we should unify fingerprint generation across streaming vs finalize pipes. Proposal: compute `billing_key = sha256(session_id + request_ns)` at edge and include as `billing_id` in both envelopes. Downstream dedupe then uses billing_id only.
Alex: Agree. That avoids changing consumer dedupe logic. But we need to ensure billing_id is stable across retries, redispatches, and also across Hosted/Dedicated/Private deployments.
Owen: I'll open RFC. Short-term fix: add `billing_id` in a hotfix branch and run a canary (5% traffic) with dedupe on consumers ignoring finalization flag. Sam from infra will help with gating.
infra-bot: action: started canary rollout 5% for commit 7f9a3d. Playbook: watch `metering.event_dups_rate` and `invoice_preview_delta` for flagged tenants for 60m.
BillingOps: Also ask Finance for permission to run a non-destructive cleanup on preview numbers post-fix. We prefer to avoid touching ledger if possible.
Priya: I'll compute before/after diffs and post CSVs. Owen, can you add smoke queries? Maybe `sum(increase(metering.tokens[10m])) by (tenant, session_type)` and `count(increase(metering.events{path=~".*(stream|finalize).*"}[10m])) by (tenant)` to watch duplicates.
Owen: Added two Grafana panels in the temp dashboard and an alert rule: `increase(metering.duplicate_events_total[15m]) / increase(metering.events_total[15m]) > 0.003` sustained 20m -> page.
Alex: Finance signoff: @BillingOps — do you need a dry-run for any backfill?
BillingOps: If we end up with ledger corrections, yes: dry-run & audit log required. But priority is to fix edge semantics and avoid backfills. We'll coordinate a small reconciliation window if any tenants request adjustments.
Priya: Results from 24h diff job: attaching mini-summary (pasted): tenant-a +2.1%, tenant-b +1.4%, tenant-c +3.3% — full CSV uploaded to /mnt/reports/metering-dup-2026-03-21.csv
Owen: Canary been 35m. Duplicate rate dropped to baseline for canaried traffic. No pager yet. Reverting flag for others while we extend the billing_id rollout seems safe.
Alex: OK action list: (1) Owen -> revert feature-flag for non-canary tenants (done within 30m) (2) Owen -> implement billing_id RFC + hotfix PR (3) Priya -> post console banner and CSV to Support + notify affected tenants (4) BillingOps -> hold on backfill until sim matches.
Priya: I'll post the banner copy here in 15m.
Owen: Opened PR https://github.com/redwood/metering/pull/732 with billing_id + unit tests. Request review from @Alex and @BillingOps.
BillingOps: Reviewing. Please include a migration plan for private deployments that might not auto-roll.
Alex: Good point. Add a migration note in the PR and an optional server-side translation to derive billing_id when missing.
Priya: Thx all. React :white_check_mark: when your item is finished and I'll close the thread.
